150m.engine: greedy k-median/facility-location screening with exact capacitated transport LP re-evaluation (HiGHS)

caveats: Transport-only screening: no capital, operating, permitting, landbase, procurement or facility-design claim.
The generic module is class-agnostic with unlimited throughput in the screen; no class-specific capacity, technology, cost, product or residue is asserted.
The k-series is a greedy heuristic, not a globally optimal siting solution; no optimality-gap claim is made.
Distances are haversine x province-factor screening distances, not observed routes for every node-module pair; no full OSRM routing.
Transport cost excludes feedstock, processing, conversion, handling, storage and product revenue.
The k-series has no local-preference penalty, so cross-border flows are unpenalised and are reported, not restricted.
Existing capacity v3 and the 1.2x provincial floor are unchanged; the existing facility set is fixed.
The 100 and 150 Mm3 cases scale each province's node harvest vector from the 119 Mm3 allocation; within-province node shares are unchanged.
NT positive nodes are not candidate module hosts because no NT road factor is published; their volume remains in the demand set.
No national claim, policy claim, UI change or official OSeCAN change is made.
This artifact is not investment advice.

method.candidate_basis: positive-volume supply nodes in provinces with a published road factor
method.capacity_basis: national_facility_capacity_v3 with the documented 1.2x provincial floor, held fixed

100m.node_basis: provincial allocation scaled from the 119 Mm3 node vector; within-province shares unchanged

119m.node_basis: committed greenfield siting v1 node vector

150m.node_basis: provincial allocation scaled from the 119 Mm3 node vector; within-province shares unchanged

method.distance_method: haversine x province road factor from facility_road_distance_audit_v2; candidate module uses its node province factor; no full OSRM routing
method.engine: greedy k-median/facility-location screening with exact capacitated transport LP re-evaluation (HiGHS)
method.heuristic: greedy forward selection; at each k the shortlist is the top 10 candidates by capacity-relaxed distance savings; every trial and every k is re-evaluated with the exact capacitated transport LP
method.k0_existing_only_baseline: existing-only re-solve with the same transport curve and capacity but zero local-preference penalty
method.module_basis: class-agnostic generic module at a candidate supply node; unlimited throughput in the screen; no class capacity, technology, cost, product or residue asserted
method.objective: minimise 2026 CAD truck transport cost from transport_cost_v1 base curve (52.5 m3 payload, empty return); no local-preference penalty in the k-series
method.optimality: heuristic screening result; not a proven global optimum; no optimality-gap claim
method.v10_existing_only_baseline: committed v10 primary assignment for 119 Mm3 and committed v10 case summary for 100/150 Mm3, including their 500 km cross-border preference penalties
